components.name: Review Rail
components.description: Sticky highest-leverage action and evidence summary.
components.html:
HIGHEST-LEVERAGE ACTION

Resolve copy before design handoff.

narrative.overview: Campaign work appears as evidence under review, not as a generic analytics dashboard. Warm proof paper, ink-dark rails, one-pixel rules, registration coral, and editorial violet create a calm operational surface where sources, notes, state, and next action remain physically connected. The system is dense but never frantic. Hierarchy comes from scale, ruling, tonal layers, and attached annotations rather than card proliferation. Tenant identity enters through one validated presentation object and CSS variables; product behavior never forks with the theme.
keyCharacteristics: Warm paper field with a fixed dark operational rail.
Campaign rows carry proof IDs, sources, notes, audience, date, and text status.
Coral registers the active artifact and consequential action; violet supports secondary active state.
Mobile becomes action-first: review rail, proofs, then compact metrics.
White-label themes fail safely to the accessible default palette.

rules.name: The Registration Rule
rules.body: Coral identifies the current consequence or next action. Do not scatter it across passive decoration.

rules.name: The Contrast Gate Rule
rules.body: Tenant palettes must pass the semantic contrast validator. Unsafe primary, hover, danger, focus, or text pairs fall back to the default presentation.

rules.name: The Evidence Type Rule
rules.body: Mono type is for traceable operational data, never for long prose or personality styling.

rules.name: The Flat-by-Default Rule
rules.body: Add shadows only when an artifact must sit above the working field; never shadow every container.

dos: Do attach evidence, provenance, status, and action to the campaign artifact they describe.
Do preserve action-first ordering on mobile.
Do keep tenant identity in BrandPresentation, project it through CSS variables, and run contrast validation.
Do use semantic landmarks, visible focus, labelled controls, text status, and reduced-motion behavior.
Do use the design seed 0a100401 when extending this visual lineage.
donts: Don't regress into a generic KPI-card dashboard or disconnected recommendation cards.
Don't fork code for tenant branding or hardcode customer identity inside reusable components.
Don't use faint text below 4.5:1, invisible focus below 3:1, or fixed foreground colors over tenant-controlled backgrounds.
Don't let secondary metrics appear before the highest-leverage action on mobile.
Don't use color-only state or decorative accents without operational meaning.
